meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 在触发后,Claude 会先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,然后召集 5 个互相敌对的成员相互挑刺,只保留经得起攻击的结论,再强制交给 plan 智能体整理成可执行的计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最严谨推敲,或说出“hyperplan”“hpp”等触发词时启用;需处于主会话、以主导智能体运行且团队模式可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我制定发布计划。
say.note: 进入对抗式多智能体规划流程。

say.text: 启动 hpp,对这份方案做敌意交叉评审。
say.note: 五个成员会互相攻击对方的漏洞。

say.text: 用对抗式规划分析我们系统的薄弱假设。
say.note: 会产出计划并交给 plan 智能体。

howto.what_en: After triggering, Claude first announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", convenes 5 mutually hostile members to cross-critique, keeps only defensible insights, and mandatorily hands them to the plan agent for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Activates when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, over-engineering. Triggers include 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', etc. Requires team mode and main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to create a release plan.
say_en.note: Starts the adversarial multi-agent planning flow.

say_en.text: Start hpp and do a hostile cross-review of this proposal.
say_en.note: The five members attack each other's weak points.

say_en.text: Use adversarial planning to analyze our system's weak assumptions.
say_en.note: It produces a plan and hands it to the plan agent.
